_comment: Prototype phrases per clause type. The extraction module embeds these with InLegalBERT and classifies a clause by nearest centroid. Keep entries short and prototypical.
INDEMNITY: The party shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the other party from and against any claims, losses, damages and expenses arising out of the agreement.
Each party agrees to indemnify the other against third party claims resulting from its breach of this agreement.
The Client shall indemnify the Service Provider for all liabilities without any monetary cap.
LIMITATION_OF_LIABILITY: In no event shall either party be liable for any indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages.
The aggregate liability of the Service Provider under this agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
Neither party shall be liable for loss of profits, revenue or goodwill.
TERMINATION: Either party may terminate this agreement for material breach that remains uncured for thirty days after written notice.
The Company may terminate this agreement for convenience upon thirty days prior written notice.
On termination all licences granted under this agreement shall immediately cease.
RENEWAL: This agreement shall automatically renew for successive one year periods unless either party gives notice of non-renewal.
The initial term shall be twelve months and shall renew automatically thereafter.
Renewal is subject to a revised fee schedule notified by the Service Provider.
PAYMENT: The Client shall pay the fees within fifteen days of receipt of a valid invoice.
Overdue amounts shall carry interest at two percent per month until paid.
All fees are exclusive of applicable goods and services tax.
CONFIDENTIALITY: Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information disclosed by the other party.
The receiving party shall not disclose confidential information to any third party without prior written consent.
Confidentiality obligations shall survive termination for a period of three years.
GOVERNING_LAW: This agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India.
The validity and interpretation of this agreement shall be governed by Indian law.
This agreement is subject to the laws in force in the Republic of India.
DISPUTE_RESOLUTION: The parties shall first attempt to resolve any dispute through good faith negotiation between senior management.
Any dispute not resolved through mediation shall be referred to arbitration.
Disputes shall be escalated in accordance with the dispute resolution procedure set out in this clause.
ARBITRATION: Any dispute arising out of this agreement shall be finally resolved by arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
The seat and venue of arbitration shall be Bengaluru and the language of arbitration shall be English.
The arbitral tribunal shall consist of a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual agreement of the parties.
JURISDICTION: The courts at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any proceedings arising out of this agreement.
Subject to the arbitration clause, the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New Delhi.
Only the courts within whose limits the registered office is situated shall have jurisdiction.
FORCE_MAJEURE: Neither party shall be liable for any delay or failure to perform caused by events beyond its reasonable control.
Force majeure events include acts of God, war, epidemic, flood, fire and action of government.
If a force majeure event continues for more than sixty days either party may terminate this agreement.
INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY: All intellectual property rights in the deliverables shall vest in the Client upon full payment.
The Service Provider retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, libraries and know-how.
Each party retains all right, title and interest in its background intellectual property.
DATA_PROTECTION: Each party shall comply with applicable data protection law including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
The processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data.
Personal data shall not be transferred outside India without the data principal's consent.
NON_COMPETE: During the term and for one year thereafter the Consultant shall not engage in any business that competes with the Company.
The employee shall not directly or indirectly carry on a competing business within the territory.
This restriction is limited to the specific line of business of the Company.
NON_SOLICITATION: Neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party during the term and for twelve months thereafter.
The Client shall not solicit or entice away any personnel engaged by the Service Provider.
This clause does not prevent hiring through a general public advertisement.
WARRANTY: The Service Provider warrants that the services shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
Each party represents and warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this agreement.
Except as expressly stated, all warranties whether express or implied are excluded.
ASSIGNMENT: Neither party may assign or transfer this agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
The Company may assign this agreement to an affiliate or in connection with a merger or sale of business.
Any purported assignment in breach of this clause shall be void.
NOTICES: Any notice under this agreement shall be in writing and delivered by hand, registered post or email to the address set out below.
Notices shall be deemed received two business days after posting or on confirmation of email delivery.
A party may change its address for notices by giving written notice to the other party.
ENTIRE_AGREEMENT: This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions and understandings.
No representation or warranty not expressly set out in this agreement shall be binding on the parties.
This agreement together with its schedules records the whole agreement between the parties.
AMENDMENT: No amendment or variation of this agreement shall be effective unless made in writing and signed by both parties.
Any modification to the scope of work shall be agreed through a written change order.
The parties may amend the fee schedule only by mutual written agreement.
SEVERABILITY: If any provision of this agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable the remaining provisions shall continue in full force.
The invalid provision shall be replaced by a valid provision that most closely reflects the intention of the parties.
The unenforceability of one clause shall not affect the validity of the rest of the agreement.
SCOPE_OF_WORK: The Service Provider shall provide software development and maintenance services as described in each statement of work.
The scope of services includes design, implementation, testing and support of the platform.
Each statement of work shall set out the deliverables, timelines and acceptance criteria.
PARTIES: This Agreement is made between Acme Technologies Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act 2013 with its registered office at Bengaluru, and Beta Ventures LLP with its principal place of business at Chennai.
This Services Agreement is entered into by and between the Company and the Consultant, each a party and together the parties.
The parties to this agreement are the Client and the Service Provider as identified above.
